verdicts.reason: A: the headline is tiny, barely bigger than the body copy, and wraps with 'back' left alone on its own line. The SOLSTICE wordmark runs over the edge of the circle, and the can is pulled off the circle. The badges hang below the row, the CTA is pushed against the right edge, and wide dead gaps leave no clear hierarchy. B: the headline is large and clearly dominant, but the wordmark sits below it, so the reading order is reversed. The body copy is jammed against the left edge on top of the circle, the can is separated from the circle, and the CTA is crammed into the badge row at the same size as the badges. B is still the less broken of the two.
